epostaPazarlama.aciklama: Newsletters, campaigns and drip sequences. Individual recipients only receive messages if they have opted in; every message carries a one-click unsubscribe link and the sender's identity.
epostaPazarlama.yasalNot: The system enforces consent records, the right to unsubscribe and sender identity. For legal advice on Turkish Law No. 6563 and İYS obligations, consult your advisor.

uyari.resendYok: The email sending service (Resend) is not configured; campaign and confirmation emails cannot be sent.
uyari.kimlikEksik: Sender identity missing: fill in the legal name and address under Site Settings › Legal details. Nothing is sent without them.
uyari.kimlikEksikMusteri: Sender identity missing: enter your legal name and address in the Settings tab. They must appear at the bottom of every message.
uyari.sahteMod: Test environment: messages are not really sent; they go to a fake inbox.

genel.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; select and copy it manually.

ozet.esikNotu: If the complaint rate exceeds 0.3% or the hard bounce rate exceeds 5% in the last 30 days (at least 50 messages), sending is suspended automatically.

iys.metin: In Turkey, service providers sending commercial electronic messages must register with İYS and upload the consents obtained from consumers. This panel does not sync with İYS automatically.
iys.madde1: Individual (consumer) recipients must give prior explicit consent for commercial messages; consents must be recorded in İYS.
iys.madde2: Merchants and tradespeople (business) may not require prior consent; the right to opt out must be offered in every message.
iys.madde3: Opt-out requests must be honoured within three business days at the latest; this system applies them instantly.
iys.yokUyari: If you will send to individual recipients, you must register with İYS first.
iys.entegrasyonYok: This is for your records only; uploading consents to İYS and receiving opt-outs from İYS are not part of this version.

kisi.retOnay: {{eposta}} will never receive messages again (permanent). Continue?
kisi.retEdildi: Unsubscribe recorded; the contact was added to the suppression list.
kisi.silOnay: {{eposta}} will be deleted permanently (data erasure request). If they unsubscribed, the suppression record is kept. Continue?
kisi.aliciTuruIpucu: Individual: consumer (prior consent required). Business: merchant/tradesperson address.
kisi.izinVar: This contact has given marketing consent (with evidence)
kisi.izinIpucu: A contact only counts as opted in with a consent source and date; individuals without consent never receive messages.
kisi.izinKaynagi: Consent source (e.g. fair form, web form)

csv.aciklama: Columns: eposta (required), ad, firma, alici_turu (bireysel/kurumsal), izin_kaynagi, izin_tarihi, etiketler.
csv.uyari: Do not upload purchased or scraped lists. Rows without a consent source and consent date are imported as "no consent" and, if individual, never receive messages.
csv.izinsizUyari: {{sayi}} individual contacts have no consent source/date: they will be imported but will not receive messages.
csv.beyan: I obtained the consent of the opted-in people in this list myself and can prove it.

crm.aciklama: Import CRM leads as contacts. Consent comes from the lead's marketing consent in the CRM; leads without it are imported without consent.

bastirma.aciklama: These addresses never receive anything. Unsubscribe and complaint records are permanent; only manually added ones can be removed.

liste.silOnay: The list "{{ad}}" and its memberships will be deleted (contacts are kept). Continue?

form.aciklama: Embed the form on your site with two lines of code or share the direct link. Signup is double opt-in: people join the list once they click the link in their email.
form.silOnay: Delete the form? It will stop working on sites where it is embedded.
form.izinliIpucu: Separate with commas; the site itself is always allowed.
form.ciftOnayNotu: The consent box is required and unticked by default; the version of the text shown and the confirmation time are stored as evidence.

kampanya.onizlemeIpucu: Short text shown next to the subject in the inbox.
kampanya.viaIpucu: Messages go out from the agency's verified domain as "Your name via mehmetkuru.dev"; replies come to your address.
kampanya.dilIpucu: Language of the footer and unsubscribe link texts.
kampanya.izinNotu: Only opted-in individuals and business recipients who have not unsubscribed receive it; suppressed, invalid and over-the-daily-limit addresses are skipped.
kampanya.testHata: The test email could not be sent.
kampanya.gonderOnay: The campaign will now be sent to {{sayi}} people. This cannot be undone. Continue?
kampanya.zamanlaOnay: The campaign will be sent to about {{sayi}} people at the selected time. Confirm?
kampanya.gonderildi: Sending started; the remaining messages are sent in batches in the background.

ab.aciklama: The chosen percentage of the audience is split in two (subject A and B); when the time is up, the better-performing subject goes to everyone else. Without open tracking the decision is unreliable.

blok.sablonOnay: The current content will be replaced by the template. Continue?
blok.yerTutucuIpucu: Use {{a}}, {{f}} or {{e}} in the text to personalise; you can give a fallback such as {{v}} for empty values.
blok.logoIpucu: Your logo from Settings; the sender name is written if there is none.
blok.metinIpucu: Blank line = new paragraph; **bold**; links as [text](https://address).

duyuru.metin:
Hello [[ad|there]],

There is news we would like to share with you. You can find the details at the link below.

bulten.giris: Hello [[ad|there]], here is what we did this month and the content we picked for you.
bulten.ozet1: The five most effective ways to speed up your website.
bulten.ozet2: Free tools that make your work easier.
bulten.kapanis: You can share your feedback by replying to this email.

kampanya.metin: Hello [[ad|there]], don't miss this offer, valid until the end of the week.
kampanya.kosul: Terms and conditions are on our website.

etkinlik.metin: Hello [[ad|there]], you are invited to an online meetup where we present our latest work.

hosgeldin.metin: Hello [[ad|there]], thank you for subscribing. From now on you'll be the first to hear about our latest content and news.

rapor.takipKapali: Open and click tracking is off (Settings); rates are not calculated.

dizi.aciklama: A drip sequence sends emails step by step to people who join a list or confirm their subscription. Anyone who unsubscribes leaves the sequence immediately.
dizi.cikisIpucu: People who reach the goal don't receive the remaining steps.

hedefler.tiklama: Clicked a link in the sequence

dizi.retNotu: Only people who join after activation enter the sequence. Individuals without consent may enter but receive no email.
dizi.silOnay: Delete the sequence? Everyone in it will exit.

ayar.kimlikAjans: The legal name and address come from Site Settings › Legal details and are printed at the bottom of every message.
ayar.kimlikMusteri: Your legal name and address are printed at the bottom of every message (required). Messages go out from the agency's domain; replies come to your address.
ayar.gonderenAdresiIpucu: A domain verified in Resend; sending from your own domain comes in a later version.
ayar.takipAciklama: Off by default for privacy. If you turn it on, an invisible pixel is added to messages and links are redirected; mention it in your privacy notice.
ayar.gunlukSinir: Max messages per recipient per day
ayar.gunlukSinirIpucu: No one receives more marketing messages than this within 24 hours.
ayar.askida: Sending is suspended ({{neden}}). Contact the administrator after cleaning your list.
ayar.webhookAciklama: In Resend › Webhooks, select the email.delivered, email.bounced and email.complained events (optionally email.opened, email.clicked) for this address; enter the signing secret in Render as the {{degisken}} environment variable.
ayar.hesaplarAciklama: Client sends go out from the agency's domain; suspend an account if complaints or bounces rise.
ayar.hesapSatiri: {{kisi}} contacts · {{gonderilen}} messages in 30 days · {{sikayet}} complaints · {{geri}} bounced

hata.genel: Something went wrong; please try again.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; wait a moment and try again.
hata.yetki: You are not allowed to do this.
hata.modul_kapali: The email marketing module is disabled for your account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You don't have email marketing permission in this account.
hata.kisi_var: This email address is already in your contacts.
hata.izin_geri_alma_ret_ile: To withdraw consent, mark the contact as unsubscribed.
hata.ret_kalici: Unsubscribing is permanent; the person can only subscribe again via the signup form (double opt-in).
hata.bastirma_kalici: Unsubscribe, complaint and bounce records cannot be removed.
hata.liste_kullaniliyor: A form or drip sequence uses this list; delete them first.
hata.adres_gecersiz: Invalid link or image address (images must be https).
hata.sutun_gecersiz: A column can hold at most 4 blocks.
hata.hedef_gerekli: Select at least one list or segment.
hata.kitle_bos: Nobody can be sent to (consent, unsubscribe and suppression rules).
hata.ab_kitle_kucuk: An A/B test needs at least 10 sendable recipients.
hata.kota_yetersiz: The monthly sending limit is not enough ({{kalan}} left, {{gerekli}} needed).
hata.resend_kurulu_degil: The email sending service is not configured.
hata.gonderen_kimligi_eksik: Sender identity (legal name and address) is missing.
hata.zaten_gonderildi: This campaign has already been sent or scheduled.
hata.duzenlenemez: Only draft campaigns can be edited.
hata.gonderilmis_kampanya: A sent campaign cannot be deleted.
hata.dosya_gecersiz: The file could not be read.
hata.eposta_sutunu_yok: No email column found in the CSV.
hata.gorsel_gecersiz: The image could not be read.
hata.depo_hatasi: The file could not be saved.
hata.aydinlatma_https: The privacy notice link must be https.
